approval_rules.READ_ONLY: approval may be avoided when no filesystem or private scope is present
approval_rules.LOCAL_FILE_READ: bounded read scope may require a scoped token without explicit approval
approval_rules.CREDENTIAL_TOUCHING: high risk and implicit approval forbidden
approval_rules.MCP_TOOL: approval required unless read-only and explicitly bounded
approval_rules.DCC_CONTROL: approval required and production admission blocked by default
approval_rules.COMFYUI_EXECUTION: approval required and production admission blocked by default
approval_rules.PLUGIN_EXECUTION: approval required and sandbox strategy required
